import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pandas.core import nanops


def enc(x):
    # numeric signature of the result dtype: bit width of the (sub)type,
    # plus 0.5 when the result stays complex (imaginary part carried)
    dt = getattr(x, "dtype", None)
    if dt is None:
        dt = np.asarray(x).dtype
    sub = getattr(dt, "subtype", dt)
    bits = float(sub.itemsize * 8)
    if sub.kind == "c":
        bits += 0.5
    return bits


# ex1: nanmedian 1-D float32, skipna=False -> float32 expected, float64 buggy
probe("ex1_nanmedian_float32", enc(nanops.nanmedian(np.array([1, np.nan, 3], dtype="float32"), skipna=False)))

# ex2: nanmedian 1-D complex128, skipna=False -> complex128 expected, float64 buggy
probe("ex2_nanmedian_complex128", enc(nanops.nanmedian(np.array([1, np.nan, 3], dtype="complex128"), skipna=False)))

# ex3: nanmedian 2-D complex64, axis=1, skipna=False -> complex64 expected, float64 buggy
probe("ex3_nanmedian_complex64_axis1", enc(nanops.nanmedian(np.array([1, np.nan, 3], dtype="complex64").reshape(1, 3), axis=1, skipna=False)))

# ex4: ddof >= count in the nanvar family -> float32 expected, float64 buggy
probe("ex4_nanvar_float32_ddof5", enc(nanops.nanvar(np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype="float32"), ddof=5)))
probe("ex4b_nanstd_float32_ddof5", enc(nanops.nanstd(np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype="float32"), ddof=5)))
probe("ex4c_nansem_float32_ddof5", enc(nanops.nansem(np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype="float32"), ddof=5)))

# ex5: DataFrame complex median, skipna=False -> complex128 expected, float64 buggy
_df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1 + 2j, np.nan], "b": [1 + 2j, 3 + 4j]})
probe("ex5_frame_complex_median", enc(_df.median(skipna=False)))

# ex6: sparse float32 DataFrame median, skipna=False -> float32 expected, float64 buggy
_sp = pd.DataFrame({"a": pd.arrays.SparseArray(np.array([1, np.nan, 3], dtype="float32"), dtype=pd.SparseDtype("float32", np.nan))})
probe("ex6_sparse_frame_median", enc(_sp.median(skipna=False)))
